titulo: “Physical” GTA 6 Copies Might Be Vulnerable To A Very Stupid But Serious Trick
texto: Grand Theft Auto 6 ditched traditional discs for its "physical" launch, with Rockstar's game being sold as a digital code-in-box at retailers beginning this week. However, it appears a packaging choice may have accidentally left the game vulnerable to thieves--assuming they have a flashlight. As shared on the forum ResetEra , users who received a physical version of Grand Theft Auto 6, at least in PEGI regions, report that the game's download code is printed directly on the inside of the cover rather than on a card or separate insert. When a flashlight is focused on the cover from the outside of the closed game case, the download code is visible in reverse. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F7LIovDySBg&t=33s In other words, there's a serious risk people could go into a store, do this trick, redeem the code, and leave the poor soul who actually buys the game off the shelf without GTA 6.

titulo: GTA 6 Owner Take-Two Is Not Interested In Selling Itself After EA Goes Private For $55 Billion
texto: Recently, the gaming giant Electronic Arts was taken private in a $55 billion sale to an investor consortium led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. Could GTA 6 owner Take-Two be the next big company that gets acquired? Don't bet on it, CEO Strauss Zelnick says. Speaking to David Rubenstein , Zelnick said Take-Two's business results have proven that it "can do very well as an independent company." He said Take-Two's business is already "at scale" and healthy enough financially with a "terrific balance sheet," as he put it. "We are not in a place where we need to be part of a bigger organization to be competitive. And in the entertainment business, scale matters," he said. Zelnick said companies that do less than a billion in annual revenue might have issues with developing, marketing, and distributing games at scale. titulo: GTA 6 Could Sell 55 Million Copies By Early Next Year, Report Says, And Average Selling Price Could Be $90
texto: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, and it's expected to be a gigantic commercial success, but just how big will the launch be? Investor's Business Daily compiled data from a series of analyst reports about the game and its owner, Take-Two, and the consensus is that it's going to be a juggernaut. In terms of sales, Brian Pitz of BMO Capital Markets said GTA 6 could sell 55 million copies during Take-Two's fiscal 2027, which ends on March 31, 2027. He said the game could sell 45 million units alone during the game's launch quarter, which is well ahead of the estimates of 34.2 million that IBD compiled. "This is an outlier in every respect," Circana's Mat Piscatella told the publication. titulo: GTA 6 And These Other Games Can Justify An $80 Price, Expert Says
texto: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases on November 19, and you'll have to pay at least $80 for it. That's a full $20 more than what GTA 5 cost in 2013 and $10 more than many other big AAA games today. Is $80 going to become the "new normal" for AAA games, or is it, along with Nintendo's Mario Kart World and Tears of the Kingdom for Switch 2 , an outlier at $80? According to Alinea Analytics researcher Rhys Elliott , $80 won't be an across-the-board new price for all games. Some developers will purposefully price their games lower to draw in more consumers--he pointed to games like Expedition 33 ($50), Phantom Blade Zero ($60), and Oblivion Remastered ($50) as examples. titulo: GTA 6 In-Game TV Show Macca & Friends Looks Ridiculous In The Best Way
texto: Rockstar Games has released the first footage of an in-game GTA 6 TV show called "Macca & Friends," which is about a sunglass-wearing pink alligator and his wetland friends in Leonida (the stand-in for Florida). One of Macca's friends is Pinchie the crab, who is Macca's landlord. Macca is also friends with a hat-wearing manatee and a flamingo. Check out the trailer below, which sets up a story where Macca needs to get money to pay his landlord. The story involves the group seemingly posing as cops and sneaking into a police station, maybe to grab some cash from an evidence locker? Macca & Friends will be available to watch on Weazel, which is GTA's version of Fox. For now, all we have is this teaser. titulo: Xbox Says Putting Ads In Games, Something No One Likes, Could Help Save Gaming
texto: Xbox Cloud Gaming now has a free ad-supported version that's rolling out as part of Microsoft's bigger push to bring more ads to Xbox. Jonathan Stringfield, who worked on Activision's advertising push and is now doing some of the same work in his title as GM for Xbox Media Solutions, said in an interview that people shouldn't see this as a move by Xbox to cram ads into all of its games. “There is zero world where there is intention--written, explicit, implicit, or otherwise--that ads will be an option in all games. It might not even be the case on all features of the console, et cetera,” he told GamesBeat . “Where we want to have these integrated is places where it makes sense--where it can actually provide value in a positive way.
